tools.name: search_opportunities
tools.description: Search active federal construction and renovation contract opportunities from SAM.gov. Filter by US state, NAICS code, keyword, or contract value tier. Returns up to 50 results ordered by most recently published. This is a per-query search, not a bulk export.

tools.name: get_opportunity
tools.description: Get details for a specific federal opportunity by its SAM.gov notice ID: scope summary, deadline, location, agency, NAICS, set-aside, and value. Incumbent contractor, past-offer counts, contract ceiling, and win-probability scoring require a RenovationRoute account.

tools.name: get_stats
tools.description: Get a real-time snapshot of active federal construction opportunities tracked by RenovationRoute. Returns total count, top states by volume, and breakdown by contract value tier.

tools.name: list_states
tools.description: List the US states with the most active federal construction opportunities on RenovationRoute, ranked by volume, with the count per state. Returns the top states, not an exhaustive list of all 50.
